Dr Venter and the BEST Technique

By: Diana Lucas | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Is this a miracle cure for anything from MS to back ache, well this is what this Dr and his patients are convinced of.

Summary:
Dr Isak Venter is a chiropractor in Nelspruit, well that’s what he officially is, but as practitioner technique called the BEST technique (Bio-energetic synchronisation technique) he believes he can cure or at least help virtually any person suffering from, Multiple Scerosis, Motor Neron Disease, back or other bone problems ……His theory in a nutshell: we are all born with an electromagnetic field within and around us that has in its patterns and energy flow the blueprint for health and how we should be if in ideal condition. But it gets disrupted by life trauma especially emotional events and when this happens we can get sicknesses. If you can revert the field and blockages you can restore health. And that is what he does with his hands alone – no machines.

While most Dr’s are skeptical of this technique – to put it mildly - there are many people who say he has helped them. In fact he has som many people who say they have been helped by his technique that he simply cannot take nay more clients, her is inundated. What DR Venter is other Dr’s to sit up and learn about B.E.S.T. We will profile some of his case studies and talk to at least one Dr who is a total sceptic.


Further information:
Isak Venter is a healer and wants to heal people with all manner of disease and says he has already – primarily Multiple Sclerosis. He studied, the Bio Energetic Syncronisation Technique in the USA under a Dr Morter. who on the website says:
“….has been a leading innovator in health care for more than 40 years. Under his direction, Morter HealthSystem has developed an expanded vision for personal health and healthcare for the 21st Century…”

In Dr Venter’s words it’s a complete system of health care apart from BEST also including a nutrition programme based on acid/alkaline balance; and guidelines for the correct choices to make in the Six Essentials for Life (what you eat, what you drink, how you exercise, how you rest, what you breathe and what you think).
Dr Venter first heard about BEST from a visiting Australian Dr in the 70’s and then attended a seminar in 1982 in Cape Town in 1982 where he was intrigued by this procedure specifically the results. His first patient was a 19 month boby :

Case Study 1 Mrs Lacea Smith
64 years old was diagnosed with severe osteoporosis several years ago. She was put on social grant for a chronic disease, no medicine would help. The right arm in front of her body unable to move it in and out, she had to be helped to dress and washed
Lacea eventually started pills, the pain got better but afterwards developed lump of the back of her hip. Dr Izak Venter started with several sessions 3-4 years ago. Her hip lump is gone, arm usable, can run walk, nothing wrong with her. She is a pensioner, doesn’t have enough money for monthly treatment but still goes to make sure body is still in balance and in a good condition. She as medical papers saying she is a chronic patient and putting her on social grant. Her daughter has also been helped with a painful knee.

Case Study 2
Mercia Meiring, had MS and was diagnosed in the 90’s and doubts her records still exist. She could hardly walk when she first came to Dr Venter, today healthy and works as
Dr Venter’s receptionist..

Case Study 3
Mr Charl du Plessis is an airside manager of an airport. He had MS now today at 60 years old fit, rides mountain bikes.. He has had an MRI at Pretoria East Hospital when he woke up one morning and the left side of his body didn’t work, he thought he had had a stroke but qualified rescue paramedic knew it wasn’t a stroke. Was diagnosed with MS in 2011, after seeing Dr Venter definite improvements so much so a recent MRI showed a lesion in base of the brain was gone. He has been on meds as well but that could not account for a lesion going. He has done 4 comrades and 2 Oceans Iron man.

Case Study 4
Mr Hendrik Grobler The Grobler family (his two sons) – One son was injured in the military, and healed. Other son had a stroke, and is recovering after being completely paralyzed. The father has been going for treatment for 22 years to Dr. Venter and is so healthy. Although he has diabetes, he never feels sick, he doesn’t even wear glasses! He said it was the best thing his wife ever made him do.
felt like he was walking on air. He does take pills for high blood pressure.






Dr Venter: “…..she could still not walk or speak lying in the cart with mucous drooping out of her mouth, what was most upsetting about her was that only one eye was looking forward the other eye was turned 90 degrees inward totally white and she was like that since birth, at some stage l suggested to the mother to do what we call infant BEST on her, the next day l was ask to proceed and what l did took 2 to 3 minutes to do, whenever l tell people about it they look at me in disbelieve but it is the holy truth, the next day both eyes were looking strait. She became a human been from that moment”.



Some of the Case studies we will speak to

1. Mercia Meiring works as a receptionist for the `DR and had MS, she is totally fine and I have asked for her medical records.
2. Mr Hendrik Grobler The Grobler family (his two sons) – One son was injured in the military, and healed. Other son had a stroke, and is recovering after being completely paralyzed. The father has been going for treatment for 22 years to Dr. Venter and is so healthy. Although he has diabetes, he never feels sick, he doesn’t even wear glasses! He said it was the best thing his wife ever made him do.
3. Mr. Sam Mduli (Only black case study) – Was in a terrible car accident he says “ There is metal in both my hands and my leg” and the doctors said he would never walk again. Now he can walk and... to his excitement he can even drive!
4. Mr Charl du Plessis – had Multiple Sclerosis (MS) and had remarkable results, the doctors told him afterwards that it was an act of god or a miracle. He’s quite the character! He speaks in the third person and said “If it’s good for Charl, it’s good for anyone else – and says people should try it, because of how great it is.” He is worried that Dr. Venter is quite old, and who will take on after he’s gone?
There are other and we will get medical records of some of them there is also the case of a dog (!!!) whose owner, Jeanine Ferreira regularly Dr Venter’s clinic.
A controversial programme because the concept that total Dynamic Wellness only happens when the healing electromagnetic field around the body is fully neutral and stable is not a medically accepted concept. In BEST’s technique this is actually what brings wellness about. To me it seems similar to Reiki.
Dr Venter believes there is no limitation to dynamic wellness which he says is our birthright. He led 17 seminars around the world.
Dr Venter: “Every person alive and has the potential to experience it, nobody is to sick to be helped. There is no difference treating a patient fibromyalgia since childhood and some one with a headache or having heartburn, the creative power that created you in the first place can recreate and heal you from any thinkable disease or problem or facture. “

Script:


CHARL: I had no left side it didn’t work.
MERCIA: The prognosis was not good.
LACEA: My left arm was close to my body like this I couldn’t move it from my body
SAM: So a very big pain to me

V/O 12 and a half sec
Dr Isak Venter, a chiropractor here in Nelspruit has been healing people with all manner of different diseases for over 30 years…he says it’s not him that does the healing but our own energy field.

Dr Venter: I am just changing your field so that in a creative healing field that is in and around the body becomes functional.

V/O
What Dr Venter practises is the Bio Energetic Synchronisation Technique or BEST …. a healing philosophy he first learnt about in 1982 at a seminar given by the founder of this procedure, Dr Milton Morter.

Dr Venter: The thing that intrigued me the most is he said in every form of life there is a life rhythm.

Link
At the centre of the BEST philosophy is the idea that our bodies are surrounded by electro magnetic fields. Dr Venter emphasizes that it is the field that identifies what needs to be fixed and does the fixing. He says he’s just the conduit

V/O 13 sec
It’s this electro-magnetic field around our body that contains the blue print for health but emotional trauma and stress can block and damage the field and so affect the bodies ability to heal itself

Dr Venter:…from smallest cell of your body to biggest constellations electro magnetic fields are involved to keep things in shape and functional and when that gets out of hand then disease and sickness is the result.

V/O 6 and a half
Mercia Meiring, first met the Dr, 20 years ago, she suffered from hereditary Multiple Sclerosis.

Mercia: I went there for my neck he said to me that MS can be cured and I really laughed about it I thought no way. I thought he was a little bit presumptuous.

V/O 6 sec
For Mercia, whose MS had such a devastating effect on her life, a cure seemed an impossibility.

Mercia: There were days when I would lie in bed completely paralysed. I couldn’t even swallow the food they put in my mouth or water.

V/O 6 sec
When Mercia went to Dr. Venter with her neck injury, she couldn’t even walk without help.

Mercia: I went in there I had to be supported and after he treated me he said stand up and I said to him I am not going to make it and he said try and he gave me his hand and the vertigo was gone the balance had restored completely and I actually walked unaided without my crutches.
Mercia: My mind was clearer. At that stage I was stuttering very bad and I was having epileptic fits. I stopped having the fits and my speech became more, clear.
John: I guess after that treatment you didn’t think he was that presumptuous?
Mercia: No I was very impressed

V/O 14 sec
So impressed Mercia ended up as Dr Venter’s receptionist and has witnessed a number of inspirational stories of recovery.
Like Lacea Smith, who 12 years ago was on chronic medication for her osteoporosis

Lacea: I struggled to walk, with my hips and if you just touch my arm it was very painful. I was crying all the time.

V/O
Lacea’s own mother had died at 54 from osteoporosis and by the time Lacea saw Dr Venter 3 years ago she thought that this too would be her fate. Her medication was not helping and her condition was so severe she was on a state grant.

Lacea: Now days I go on Mountain hikes everything I run with my grandchildren, its amazing he just use his I don’t know how to explain, pressure points on me…and he also tells me focus on your problem while he is doing it. It is to get you in a state of positivity,

Dr Venter; Focus on this mental emotional condition you have had…most stressful in your life

V/O 12 and a half sec
Part of the BEST philosophy is working through our negative emotions, which play an enormous role in our state of wellness. If you don’t they believe your bodies healing field becomes contaminated.

John What would you say to people who were a little bit skeptical about this?
Lacea: It is working I can prove it because it happened with my self. I could have been dead by now.

V/O 3 sec
Another success story is Sam Mduli.

Laugh

V/O 10 and a half sec
Seven years ago Sam had a terrible car accident after months in and out of hospital and years of using crutches and wheel chairs eventually found Dr Venter, three years ago.

LINK
This pile of documentation is the result of Sam’s time in hospital the medical opinion based on the result of all this evaluation is that Sam would never walk again he says the only reason that didn’t happen is because of Dr Venter’s intervention.

Sam: Now my leg was trying to be equal but not exactly it was 3 cm short.
Dr Venter: He was brought in here and I started working on him that was 2 years ago.
Sam When I started to attend the treatment I started to feel the blood flow in my leg.
Dr Venter: At the end of first week he threw away one crutch at the end of
Sam….now I can walk

V/O 8 and a half sec
Sam’s initial sessions were painful, but he persevered, today he’s no longer even addicted to the painkillers he was on for 6 years

Sam: So if the pain now is ….. wheel

V/O 15 and a half
It looks like a regular session of phsysio but it’s not. BEST uses a non-forceful, balancing hands on technique to restore your field.
A magnet is also used, but just to verify the bodies distorted electro magnetic pattern

Dr Venter: What we are going to re boot your computer and we are going to see how things are going to change for the better.

V/O 11 sec
Airside manager of Kruger Mpumalanga International Airport, Charl du Plessis woke up one morning in March 2011 to find the left side of his body didn’t work

Charl: My entire arm and left leg didn’t respond to climbing out the left side of the bed, having been a past qualified rescue paramedic I immediately thought I had had a stroke

V/O 6 sec
But it wasn’t a stroke, as initially thought, Charl was eventually diagnosed with Multiple Sclerosis.

Charl It was another shock you relieved it wasn’t a stroke but how do I manage MS

V/O 4 and a half sec
And an MRI scan showed a lesion in the base of his brain.

John: Nobody likes a lesion.
Charl: Yes like a foreign body in your brain it doesn’t belong

LINK
Charl was coming to terms with his MS diagnosis and trying to manage the pain down the left hand side of his body when a conversation with a work colleague changed his life he was shown an article about Dr Isak Venter and with nothing to lose decided to go and see him

Charl: I limped into his offices and started the treatment I sincerely mean it when Dr. Venter touched my ankles I honestly felt a rather strange sensation.

V/O 15 sec
Initially Charl saw Dr Venter 2 to 3 times week, which stabilized to once a month… He does also take a managing medication for his MS….today he’s back in the saddle…literally. And in another X Ray taken this year

Charl: Up Sound

V/O 9 sec
Whilst BEST is taught at several colleges in the United States and is recognised as an effective healing science, it is still a controversial form of treatment. Most Dr ‘s and specialists in our medical fields call it a con.

John: Why are the rest of medical profession so skeptical?
Dr. Venter: Because it’s contrary to their belief that medicine is the only answer to take care of wellness in the body but I am not here today to talk about them I know there service is just as necessary its just important at some stage we can together.

V/O 5 and a half sec
Dr Venter has no shortage of patients, and at 80 years old he not looking for more.

LINK
Its hard to make a proper assessment to Dr Venter’s work after 1 brief session and the temptation is to dismiss it out of hand as absolute quackery but even the sceptic in me cant ignore the fact to a great many people Dr V is and has been their only hope

V/O 4 sec 20 frames
Like Charl, who says that even if it’s just mind over matter,…it’s working.

Charl: I am back on bicycle hiking I feel a normal human being…good to back all I can say what Dr. Venter has done for me I believe he can do for others …
…if it is the placebo effect than so be it

V/O 6 sec For Mercia, whose MS had such a devastating effect on her life, a cure seemed an impossibility. Mercia: There were days when I would lie in bed completely paralysed. I couldn’t even swallow the food they put in my mouth or water. V/O 6 sec When Mercia went to Dr. Venter with her neck injury, she couldn’t even walk without help. Mercia: I went in there I had to be supported and after he treated me he said stand up and I said to him I am not going to make it and he said try and he gave me his hand and the vertigo was gone the balance had restored completely and I actually walked unaided without my crutches. Mercia: My mind was clearer. At that stage I was stuttering very bad and I was having epileptic fits. I stopped having the fits and my speech became more, clear. John: I guess after that treatment you didn’t think he was that presumptuous? Mercia: No I was very impressed V/O 14 sec So impressed Mercia ended up as Dr Venter’s receptionist and has witnessed a number of inspirational stories of recovery. Like Lacea Smith, who 12 years ago was on chronic medication for her osteoporosis Lacea: I struggled to walk, with my hips and if you just touch my arm it was very painful. I was crying all the time. V/O Lacea’s own mother had died at 54 from osteoporosis and by the time Lacea saw Dr Venter 3 years ago she thought that this too would be her fate. Her medication was not helping and her condition was so severe she was on a state grant. Lacea: Now days I go on Mountain hikes everything I run with my grandchildren, its amazing he just use his I don’t know how to explain, pressure points on me…and he also tells me focus on your problem while he is doing it. It is to get you in a state of positivity, Dr Venter; Focus on this mental emotional condition you have had…most stressful in your life V/O 12 and a half sec Part of the BEST philosophy is working through our negative emotions, which play an enormous role in our state of wellness. If you don’t they believe your bodies healing field becomes contaminated. John What would you say to people who were a little bit skeptical about this? Lacea: It is working I can prove it because it happened with my self. I could have been dead by now. V/O 3 sec Another success story is Sam Mduli. Laugh V/O 10 and a half sec Seven years ago Sam had a terrible car accident after months in and out of hospital and years of using crutches and wheel chairs eventually found Dr Venter, three years ago. LINK This pile of documentation is the result of Sam’s time in hospital the medical opinion based on the result of all this evaluation is that Sam would never walk again he says the only reason that didn’t happen is because of Dr Venter’s intervention. Sam: Now my leg was trying to be equal but not exactly it was 3 cm short. Dr Venter: He was brought in here and I started working on him that was 2 years ago. Sam When I started to attend the treatment I started to feel the blood flow in my leg. Dr Venter: At the end of first week he threw away one crutch at the end of Sam….now I can walk V/O 8 and a half sec Sam’s initial sessions were painful, but he persevered, today he’s no longer even addicted to the painkillers he was on for 6 years Sam: So if the pain now is ….. wheel V/O 15 and a half It looks like a regular session of phsysio but it’s not. BEST uses a non-forceful, balancing hands on technique to restore your field. A magnet is also used, but just to verify the bodies distorted electro magnetic pattern Dr Venter: What we are going to re boot your computer and we are going to see how things are going to change for the better. V/O 11 sec Airside manager of Kruger Mpumalanga International Airport, Charl du Plessis woke up one morning in March 2011 to find the left side of his body didn’t work Charl: My entire arm and left leg didn’t respond to climbing out the left side of the bed, having been a past qualified rescue paramedic I immediately thought I had had a stroke V/O 6 sec But it wasn’t a stroke, as initially thought, Charl was eventually diagnosed with Multiple Sclerosis. Charl It was another shock you relieved it wasn’t a stroke but how do I manage MS V/O 4 and a half sec And an MRI scan showed a lesion in the base of his brain. John: Nobody likes a lesion. Charl: Yes like a foreign body in your brain it doesn’t belong LINK Charl was coming to terms with his MS diagnosis and trying to manage the pain down the left hand side of his body when a conversation with a work colleague changed his life he was shown an article about Dr Isak Venter and with nothing to lose decided to go and see him Charl: I limped into his offices and started the treatment I sincerely mean it when Dr. Venter touched my ankles I honestly felt a rather strange sensation. V/O 15 sec Initially Charl saw Dr Venter 2 to 3 times week, which stabilized to once a month… He does also take a managing medication for his MS….today he’s back in the saddle…literally. And in another X Ray taken this year Charl: Up Sound V/O 9 sec Whilst BEST is taught at several colleges in the United States and is recognised as an effective healing science, it is still a controversial form of treatment. Most Dr ‘s and specialists in our medical fields call it a con. John: Why are the rest of medical profession so skeptical? Dr. Venter: Because it’s contrary to their belief that medicine is the only answer to take care of wellness in the body but I am not here today to talk about them I know there service is just as necessary its just important at some stage we can together. V/O 5 and a half sec Dr Venter has no shortage of patients, and at 80 years old he not looking for more. LINK Its hard to make a proper assessment to Dr Venter’s work after 1 brief session and the temptation is to dismiss it out of hand as absolute quackery but even the sceptic in me cant ignore the fact to a great many people Dr V is and has been their only hope V/O 4 sec 20 frames Like Charl, who says that even if it’s just mind over matter,…it’s working. Charl: I am back on bicycle hiking I feel a normal human being…good to back all I can say what Dr. Venter has done for me I believe he can do for others … …if it is the placebo effect than so be it

metadata.Summary: Dr Isak Venter is a chiropractor in Nelspruit, well that’s what he officially is, but as practitioner technique called the BEST technique (Bio-energetic synchronisation technique) he believes he can cure or at least help virtually any person suffering from, Multiple Scerosis, Motor Neron Disease, back or other bone problems ……His theory in a nutshell: we are all born with an electromagnetic field within and around us that has in its patterns and energy flow the blueprint for health and how we should be if in ideal condition. But it gets disrupted by life trauma especially emotional events and when this happens we can get sicknesses. If you can revert the field and blockages you can restore health. And that is what he does with his hands alone – no machines. While most Dr’s are skeptical of this technique – to put it mildly - there are many people who say he has helped them. In fact he has som many people who say they have been helped by his technique that he simply cannot take nay more clients, her is inundated. What DR Venter is other Dr’s to sit up and learn about B.E.S.T. We will profile some of his case studies and talk to at least one Dr who is a total sceptic.
metadata.Further information: Isak Venter is a healer and wants to heal people with all manner of disease and says he has already – primarily Multiple Sclerosis. He studied, the Bio Energetic Syncronisation Technique in the USA under a Dr Morter. who on the website says: “….has been a leading innovator in health care for more than 40 years. Under his direction, Morter HealthSystem has developed an expanded vision for personal health and healthcare for the 21st Century…” In Dr Venter’s words it’s a complete system of health care apart from BEST also including a nutrition programme based on acid/alkaline balance; and guidelines for the correct choices to make in the Six Essentials for Life (what you eat, what you drink, how you exercise, how you rest, what you breathe and what you think). Dr Venter first heard about BEST from a visiting Australian Dr in the 70’s and then attended a seminar in 1982 in Cape Town in 1982 where he was intrigued by this procedure specifically the results. His first patient was a 19 month boby : Case Study 1 Mrs Lacea Smith 64 years old was diagnosed with severe osteoporosis several years ago. She was put on social grant for a chronic disease, no medicine would help. The right arm in front of her body unable to move it in and out, she had to be helped to dress and washed Lacea eventually started pills, the pain got better but afterwards developed lump of the back of her hip. Dr Izak Venter started with several sessions 3-4 years ago. Her hip lump is gone, arm usable, can run walk, nothing wrong with her. She is a pensioner, doesn’t have enough money for monthly treatment but still goes to make sure body is still in balance and in a good condition. She as medical papers saying she is a chronic patient and putting her on social grant. Her daughter has also been helped with a painful knee. Case Study 2 Mercia Meiring, had MS and was diagnosed in the 90’s and doubts her records still exist. She could hardly walk when she first came to Dr Venter, today healthy and works as Dr Venter’s receptionist.. Case Study 3 Mr Charl du Plessis is an airside manager of an airport. He had MS now today at 60 years old fit, rides mountain bikes.. He has had an MRI at Pretoria East Hospital when he woke up one morning and the left side of his body didn’t work, he thought he had had a stroke but qualified rescue paramedic knew it wasn’t a stroke. Was diagnosed with MS in 2011, after seeing Dr Venter definite improvements so much so a recent MRI showed a lesion in base of the brain was gone. He has been on meds as well but that could not account for a lesion going. He has done 4 comrades and 2 Oceans Iron man. Case Study 4 Mr Hendrik Grobler The Grobler family (his two sons) – One son was injured in the military, and healed. Other son had a stroke, and is recovering after being completely paralyzed. The father has been going for treatment for 22 years to Dr. Venter and is so healthy. Although he has diabetes, he never feels sick, he doesn’t even wear glasses! He said it was the best thing his wife ever made him do. felt like he was walking on air. He does take pills for high blood pressure. Dr Venter: “…..she could still not walk or speak lying in the cart with mucous drooping out of her mouth, what was most upsetting about her was that only one eye was looking forward the other eye was turned 90 degrees inward totally white and she was like that since birth, at some stage l suggested to the mother to do what we call infant BEST on her, the next day l was ask to proceed and what l did took 2 to 3 minutes to do, whenever l tell people about it they look at me in disbelieve but it is the holy truth, the next day both eyes were looking strait. She became a human been from that moment”. Some of the Case studies we will speak to 1. Mercia Meiring works as a receptionist for the `DR and had MS, she is totally fine and I have asked for her medical records. 2. Mr Hendrik Grobler The Grobler family (his two sons) – One son was injured in the military, and healed. Other son had a stroke, and is recovering after being completely paralyzed. The father has been going for treatment for 22 years to Dr. Venter and is so healthy. Although he has diabetes, he never feels sick, he doesn’t even wear glasses! He said it was the best thing his wife ever made him do. 3. Mr. Sam Mduli (Only black case study) – Was in a terrible car accident he says “ There is metal in both my hands and my leg” and the doctors said he would never walk again. Now he can walk and... to his excitement he can even drive! 4. Mr Charl du Plessis – had Multiple Sclerosis (MS) and had remarkable results, the doctors told him afterwards that it was an act of god or a miracle. He’s quite the character! He speaks in the third person and said “If it’s good for Charl, it’s good for anyone else – and says people should try it, because of how great it is.” He is worried that Dr. Venter is quite old, and who will take on after he’s gone? There are other and we will get medical records of some of them there is also the case of a dog (!!!) whose owner, Jeanine Ferreira regularly Dr Venter’s clinic. A controversial programme because the concept that total Dynamic Wellness only happens when the healing electromagnetic field around the body is fully neutral and stable is not a medically accepted concept. In BEST’s technique this is actually what brings wellness about. To me it seems similar to Reiki. Dr Venter believes there is no limitation to dynamic wellness which he says is our birthright. He led 17 seminars around the world. Dr Venter: “Every person alive and has the potential to experience it, nobody is to sick to be helped. There is no difference treating a patient fibromyalgia since childhood and some one with a headache or having heartburn, the creative power that created you in the first place can recreate and heal you from any thinkable disease or problem or facture. “
